utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the twelfth. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, you're coming through. Bit tinny, but we're used to that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'm in the portakabin. The heating in here seems to have two settings: absolutely nothing and blast furnace. Just moaning, before that goes on a list.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good clarification. I could practically hear the action log opening.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: There's a birthday cake in the office, anyway. That has improved the Monday situation.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Whose birthday?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No idea. Didn't want to hold up the cake asking technical questions.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And there's the charity bake sale on Friday. Not volunteering us for anything, just saying it's a dangerous week for cake.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Excellent. A balanced diet, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we spend the whole stand-up on sponge. What's already closed out?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the cooling tower on Tuesday. That's finished, nothing outstanding from that inspection.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Closed, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I tested the GT2 yesterday and it's all fine now. That's the completed test, not a request for another run.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: On GT2—sorry, slightly different thing—the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the GT2 bearing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, separate issue. That delivery's still blocked on their confirmation; we're not adding a fresh chasing action here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. Just don't want 'test fine' to sound like the bearing's arrived.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the waste heat boiler yesterday as well. That one's done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, saw that in the handover. No repeat job there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you order spare parts for the HV board? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll order spare parts for the HV board. Understood, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit there. Was that the HV board?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: The HV board, yeah. That's the order I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Jamie. No separate deadline on that one, just the priority we've said.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Got it. Audio's doing that little underwater thing for me too.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: It's Monday. Even the Wi-Fi hasn't warmed up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, the other one: can you swap the filter on the CT1 after lunch, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can't take that one, sorry. I haven't got the hands-on cover to leave stores after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, not with Jamie then. Olumide, could you swap the filter on the CT1 after lunch, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that instead. I'll swap the filter on the CT1 after lunch, if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the CT1 one, not the waste heat boiler one I just mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, CT1. Yours is already done; different filter.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Olumide has that now, not Jamie, and it's a spare-minute job after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Thanks. Didn't want to say yes and then leave everyone thinking it was covered by me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Makes a change from the usual enthusiastic yes followed by a disappearing act.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: While I've got the mic, I'll sort the training records for the new starters next week. No rush on that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: The records, rather than another training session, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, just sorting the training records for the new starters. That's what I'm volunteering for.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Olumide. Next week, no rush. Agreed.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine. Just keeping the wording straight, not adding anything else.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, fair. 'Training' on its own ends up meaning about six different things.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll inspect the boiler safety valve for leaks on Friday. I'll drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. So on Friday, that's the one taking precedence.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. On Friday, not pulling it forward to this morning, but drop everything for that one when it comes round.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. The high priority and the Friday timing are both clear.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, I spoke over the end there—wasn't disputing it. Your audio just caught up with mine.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No worries. Teams makes us all sound like we're having an argument.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's agreed, Hannah.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll replace the seals on the Water Booster Pump next Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Next Tuesday for the Water Booster Pump seals, Tomasz. That's agreed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, next Tuesday. That's the seal replacement I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Mm, clear.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, heard that properly this time.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I'll book a contractor to look at the water system today. No rush, though.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Booking today, rather than saying the contractor has to be here today?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's it. I'll make the booking today. No rush within today, and I'm not giving a visit date.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Tomasz. Book a contractor to look at the water system today, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good distinction. Booking and attendance aren't the same deadline.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. Otherwise someone hears 'today' and expects a van at the gate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any observations before we finish? Not extra jobs disguised as an 'oh, by the way'.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just an observation: I saw the pressure on the pick and place on two dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, a brief dip and recovered by itself.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. Just reporting what I saw, not raising a job for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. We've separated the completed bits and the supplier blocker from the agreed work. Everyone clear?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, all clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks, everyone. I'll let you escape the little squares.
